## Sharper Streyn logo
- **New wordmark:** the Streyn lettering is now drawn as vector outlines, so it stays crisp at every size, in the app, on the website and in the docs
- **Cleaner logo:** the note in the circle is redrawn with clean lines instead of a traced picture, for the app icon on Android, Windows and Linux and the browser tab
- **Sidebar and phone header** show the new lettering next to the logo

## Website
- New shots section: the app on PC and phone in the room, the three looks side by side, a film roll of phone screens, close-ups and a chillscreen reel
- All screenshots taken fresh from the current version

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
